meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
You entered a zero on my son's essay a week ago, and he found out on his phone in the middle of a class, Hale. Nobody called me. I have twenty minutes, so tell me who decided that, and on what basis.
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. I'm writing that down. Was Owen heard before you entered it?
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.

"Like, being stuck" is a fair description of a lot of seventeen-year-olds asked a vocabulary question by a teacher with no warning, Hale. I want to see that note, with the date on it, and I want to know who else was in the room. What else do you have?
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.

Students change their minds between an outline and a final draft; that's what an outline is for. I'll want a copy of both, the outline and the essay, side by side. Whatever comes of this, Hale, it stays off his record and it stays quiet.
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

Thursday at 8:15, in your room, with no other students there and nothing said to his class, and he does it to put this behind him, not because he did anything. I want the written promise that nothing goes on file before he sits down Thursday, not Friday at 3 PM. Agree to that, Hale, and we're done.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you agreed that Owen will do a supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 in your room, that the new mark will replace the zero, and that nothing will go on his record. I still require that no other students be present, that nothing be said to his class, and that the written promise that nothing goes on file reach me before he sits the rewrite, not after. I expect that promise in writing before Thursday at 8:15.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, agreeing to a private supervised rewrite on the condition that she gets the written no-record promise before Thursday at 8:15.
What moved her: the dated October 15 outline arguing cowardice, which the essay never mentions, coming right after the dated November 2 note.
